product_summary: Corn wet-milling / starch-processing complex (units at Vapi, Gujarat and Badnawar, MP). Real product lines per own website (kasyapsweetners.com, homepage, read 2026): (1) Sorbitol — 'D-sorbitol, D-glucitol', made by high-pressure hydrogenation of dextrose over Ni catalyst; (2) Corn syrups — Liquid Dextrose, Liquid Glucose, High Maltose Corn Syrup, High Fructose Corn Syrup (HFCS); (3) Corn derivatives — Corn Germ, Corn Gluten, Corn Fiber; (4) Dextrose, Corn Starch (named in 'Who we are' text). Also states planned expansion of bulk-drug capacity at GIDC Vapi (2,400 -> 13,500 tpm, per ProjectsToday quote on own site) — i.e. pharma-grade sugars/API intermediates, not a separate product line.
comment: HS 2905.44 (sorbitol) — EXACT match, and it is the company's flagship line ('largest exporter of Sorbitol from Asia Pacific', own claim). HS 1302.32 is WRONG for this company: 1302.32 covers mucilages/gums from locust bean, guar, aloe, etc. — Kasyap is a corn refiner, not a gum/mucilage producer; no gum or mucilage product appears anywhere on the site. Correct code for the syrup/starch side is 1702.30/1702.40/1702.60/1702.90 (glucose, HFCS, high-maltose syrups), 1108.12 (corn starch), 3505.10 (dextrins/modified starch), 2303.10/2303.20 (corn gluten feed) and 2302.10 (corn fiber). Per project rule 3 the company is NOT rejected for the HS mismatch — code corrected, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is only partly right: the real classification is starch/sugar processing (corn wet milling) with pharma, oral-care, cosmetics and paints as end markets — a chemical/ingredient processor rather than an FMCG brand. Product lines MISSING from the declaration: HFCS, high-maltose corn syrup, liquid dextrose, corn starch, dextrins, corn gluten, corn germ, corn fiber (feed-grade co-products). Trader signs: none — own manufacturing units at Vapi and Badnawar, own brand, own technical documentation; role = manufacturer. All product data above is from the company's own website only; no customs line was available to me in this task, therefore every product/volume claim is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' (including the '90 countries' and 'largest sorbitol exporter' statements). Sub-pages (/products, /sorbitol, /corn-syrup, /corn-derivatives) returned 404 and the search backend was unreachable, so the product list is limited to the homepage enumeration; no further corroboration obtained. Revenue/export volumes not researched per role scope — null.
